name: last30days-skill
description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
one_liner: A research assistant that reads what real people are actually saying across Reddit, X, YouTube and prediction markets on any topic, then gives you a plain summary of what's actually happening.
buyer: A market researcher or VC analyst who needs a fast, grounded read on how a trend or product is actually landing with the public, before spending real money on a formal study.
business_use_cases: A VC analyst runs it before a diligence call to see what real users and bettors on prediction markets think about a sector, catching hype versus substance early.
A brand agency uses it to track how a client's product launch is actually being received in the wild, faster than a traditional social-listening tool.
A niche newsletter writer uses it to generate a weekly 'what the internet actually thinks about X' column with real citations.

money_ideas.idea: A paid weekly trend-research newsletter built on its output
One-off custom research reports sold to agencies and investors

steal_this: Pick one hot topic this weekend, run the skill, and publish a free 'what people are really saying' report to attract your first paying research client.
